_comment: Company slugs for keyless ATS job-board APIs. Greenhouse, Lever and
Ashby serve public JSON with no auth, but none lets you enumerate
companies, so the slug has to be known. Hence this file.
A seed, not a registry. harvest_slugs() in tools/search/ats_search.py
adds any slug it sees in an apply URL, so the list grows on its own.
Entries go stale when a company changes ATS; a slug that 404s is
Every slug below was probed live on 2026-08-23 and returned at least
one open role. 32 plausible-looking candidates were dropped for
returning nothing - an unverified list is how you ship a source that
silently finds less than it should.
